lead_raw_text:
The structure of Rb2Y3CrO8 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4_1/a (No. 143), with 26 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cr in tetrahedral O coordination and Y in octahedral O coordination, while Rb exhibits a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 O neighbors. O-centered environments include two- and three-neighbor motifs, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-sharing between Cr tetrahedra and Y octahedra, plus corner- and face-sharing between Y octahedra and Rb polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 26 sites.
